aiOverview.content: The 130th Boston Marathon will take place on Monday, April 20, 2026. Known as the world's oldest annual marathon, it is held on Patriots' Day. This 26.22-mile race features six start waves to improve flow and is expected to attract over 24,000 participants, with a cut-off time of 4:34 for qualifying applicants. Key 2026 Marathon Details: Date: Monday, April 20, 2026 (Patriots' Day). Schedule: Elite wheelchair starts are around 9:00 a.m., followed by professional waves starting around 9:37 a.m.. Format: Six waves will depart between 10:00 a.m. and roughly 11:30 a.m.. Course: The race spans 26.22 miles, running from Hopkinton to Boston, featuring a net downhill start with significant hills later in the course. Registration: Registration is available through the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.). Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.) Registration & Qualifying Results For 2026, 24,362 runners were accepted out of 33,249 applications, with a 4:34 cut-off time. Qualifying standards for the 2026 race include age-group times ranging, for instance, from 2:55:00 for men 18–34 to 3:45:00 for women 45-49. Course Info The race starts in Hopkinton, MA, and finishes on Boylston Street in Boston. The course is a net downhill for the first 4-5 miles, but requires careful pacing to avoid early quad fatigue, followed by challenging hills later, specifically in Newton. Event Experience The 2026 medals feature a shield with a black and gold design. The race is organized by the Boston Athletic Association.
